sourceTitle: The Art of Drinking: A Historical Sketch
description: "The Art of Drinking: A Historical Sketch" by Georg Gottfried Gervinus is a philosophical examination of the cultural significance of wine and the practice of drinking, written in the late 19th century. This historical account investigates the evolution of drinking customs, particularly in relation to societal development and civilization, suggesting that an understanding of potology offers insights into human culture and morality.
